When entering the PNC sub state COMM_PNC_REQUESTED, then the ComM module shall set the PNC bit with value ‘1’ of the PNC bit representing this PNC within the IRA and forward the aggregated internal PNC requests to each channel which is referenced this PNC by calling Nm_UpdateIRA(<channel>, <IRA>) under either of the following conditions:  ComMPncGatewayEnabled is set to FALSE  ComMPncGatewayType is not set on any of the ComMChannels referenced by this PNC
